question: What boundless good fortune is requested from Śaṅkara in this dedication?
premises: The petitioner asks Śaṅkara to make good fortune.
The good fortune is described as many crores and infinite.
The offering is dedicated to Śaṅkara.
inference: The formula requests Śaṅkara to grant boundless, immense good fortune and dedicates the offering to him.
plain_english: O Śaṅkara, grant infinite good fortune of many crores; this is for Śaṅkara.
